Text: Data notes

Text: Sources: EIA-861 (reliability, sales, customers; 2013-2024 via PUDL, 2025 final release of Oct 7, 2026); NOAA Storm Events (storm county-days); EIA-930 (PJM DOM zone hourly demand; 2026 runs through the hour ending midnight, Oct 29); EAGLE-I county outages 2015-2025 (ORNL, CC BY 4.0). Method: SAIDI, SAIFI and CAIDI exclude major event days unless stated; indices are customer-weighted (sum numerators, sum denominators, divide once). Correlations show association, not cause. The weather-adjusted series is a model estimate from a 2015-2024 fit. Data snapshot: Nov 1, 2026, Import mode from the CSV files in the DataFolder parameter (no live connection).
Table: All 31 data tests pass. Tests run on each build of the data (data/output/test_results.csv; definitions in docs/03_data_quality.md).
Table: Rebuilt values match the published ones (12 of 12). Rebuilt from public files vs the published source (data/output/reconciliation.csv).
